issue.title: Deck-view P transitions on a 14k-line Reply miss the D10 max<1000ms budget under load; re-measure on a quiet host and fix or guard
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-1b1.8.2 (D10 P-transition budgets). After the badge-first mitigation (80fbe7020), the standard 5k-line Reply passes all D10 budgets even under load (p50 31-45ms, p95 46-70ms). The pathological 14k-line Reply still fails its `max < 1000ms, no stall-watchdog row` budget under load (loadavg ~19): page_blocks_to_page_cards 2332ms, page_blocks_to_spread 2983ms, page_cards_to_page_blocks 1820ms, with watchdog rows during warmup. Badge p50s were good (39-69ms). Stall stacks put the remaining on-loop cost in Textual's own `Visual.to_strips -> Strip._apply_link_style` walk over ~14k strips during the real body paint (the Rich render is already off-thread).

athena has been at load 16-22 continuously (see sase-14x), so no quiet-host sample exists. Work: re-measure `tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_deck_view.py` (slow marker, run by path) on a quiet host (load < ~4). If max still misses, either cut the on-loop link-style walk (e.g. pre-apply link style off-thread in panel_view_deferred / avoid per-strip link walk) or add the D10 step-3 measured guard explained in the UI and in docs/ace.md "Deck Views", with its threshold taken from the quiet numbers.

task_type_fields.impact: Pressing P on a very long Reply can freeze the TUI for 2-3s on a loaded host.
task_type_fields.location: src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/decks/panel_view_deferred.py / Textual Strip._apply_link_style on body paint; tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_deck_view.py
task_type_fields.repro: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -m slow tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_deck_view.py (pathological 14k Reply) under load: max 1.8-3.0s on three transitions plus watchdog rows

issue.creation_reason: sase-1b1.8.2 shipped the badge-first mitigation but could not get a quiet-host sample, so the pathological budget decision was deferred.
